claims.statement: The exercised configured model and reviewed generic partitions detect, autonomously correct, sweep, and terminate represented foundation-integrity episodes without regressing negative controls.

population.partitionRule: Versioned reviewed fixtures partition current foundation behavior by trigger applicability, main confirmation disposition, propagation boundary, protected ambiguity, evidence preservation, and anti-loop termination.
population.residualSpace: Provider/model generalization, consumer-specific semantics, missing or contradictory project authority, non-OpenSpec planning implementations, and unrepresented mismatch classes remain outside the claim.

materialExclusions: Semantic correctness for every consumer project
Autonomous selection among unresolved protected product identities
Provider or model generalization beyond the captured route
Consumer repository migration or product implementation
Deployment, release, remote mutation, credentials, cost, or protected actions
unknowns: No configured baseline or candidate workflow has been captured.
The installed loader and permission boundary has not been observed for the new artifacts.
No partition member has a terminal observation.
The required fresh evidence-sufficiency challenge has not run.
claims.maximumSupportedClaim: Planning artifacts define the intended foundation-integrity workflow and proof population; no runtime behavior claim is currently supported.
